title: Malware campaign through WhatsApp attachments
summary: CERT-In reported a large-scale campaign targeting WhatsApp Desktop and WhatsApp Web users with malicious attachments distributed through compromised accounts.

indicators.description: Unexpected attachments received from a compromised or familiar account should be treated cautiously.
A message can appear trustworthy when it originates from an account that has itself been compromised.

actions: Verify unusual requests through an independent channel.
Keep operating systems and applications updated.
Report suspected cybercrime through official channels when appropriate.
